title: Lebanon National Calendar for Vaccination (2026–2030)
content: Official Ministry of Public Health national vaccination calendar. At birth: Hepatitis B, zero dose in hospital. At 2 months: IPV (inactivated polio vaccine), Penta (DPT, Hib, Hepatitis B), and rotavirus vaccine, first doses. At 4 months: IPV, Penta, and rotavirus, second doses; pneumococcal vaccine PCV13, first dose. At 6 months: OPV (oral polio vaccine), Penta, and rotavirus, third doses; PCV13, second dose. At 9 months: measles, zero dose. At 12 months: MMR first dose and PCV13 booster. At 18 months: OPV and Penta first boosters and MMR second dose. At 4–5 years: OPV and DPT second boosters. At 10–12 years: OPV and dT third boosters. At 16–18 years: OPV and dT fourth boosters. This is the official national calendar; a clinician should confirm catch-up schedules or changes needed because of an individual child's medical history.
